cells.value: A tool card is one page per app: the one route to use, which login, what it reaches and can change (tested, with the date), and its rules, with the hazards and the asks first. A skill is a step-by-step job that uses one or more tools. How the cards reach every AI: (1) the always-loaded App rules block names every card and says to read it before the first call, plus the two cross-app rules (name the login; samples can send or spend, budgets ask Alex and never go through proxy) (blind split test 2026-10-01: work/2026-10-01_setup-playbook/notes/app-rules-redesign.md); (2) the hosted notes tool Composio CUSTOM_IR_NOTES_GET_APP_RULES returns a full card on any machine, and its description lists every card with its index line; (3) the card files themselves (~/.agents/tools/cards). Hard stops are also enforced by the guard hooks. Edit the card and commit ~/.agents: the hook updates the hosted notes, the instructions and this tab. Never edit the sheet by hand.
